Fixture · Programme

Programme

Everything on at the hall over the coming weeks. Times are door times.

Open Mic Comedy

Wed 23 Sep 2026, 7:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

Five minutes each for anyone who signs up. Sign-up opens at 6:30pm at the bar; the running order is drawn from a hat. New acts are welcome and regulars are asked to bring new material. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights.

Free · Details and tickets

Repair Cafe

Thu 24 Sep 2026, 10:00am

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

Bring a broken thing — a lamp, a jumper, a bike, a toaster — and sit with a volunteer who helps you fix it. Tools and common spare parts on the bench; sewing machines at the back. Under-18s welcome with an adult until 9pm.

Free · Details and tickets

Philosophy Reading Group

Fri 25 Sep 2026, 6:30pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

This month the group reads the first half of Iris Murdoch's The Sovereignty of Good. No background needed; the discussion starts from the text and stays there. Part of the hall's spring programme; see the full list on this page.

$5 · Details and tickets

Life Drawing (untutored)

Sat 26 Sep 2026, 6:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

Two hours with a live model, short poses first then two long ones. Easels and boards provided, bring your own paper and charcoal. Sixteen places. Ask at the bar about the concession rate.

$15 · Details and tickets

Jazz in the Hall

Sun 27 Sep 2026, 8:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

The house quartet play two sets of standards with a guest horn player each month. Doors at 7:30pm, cabaret seating, licensed bar. Doors thirty minutes before the listed time.

$25 · Details and tickets

Board Game Library Night

Mon 28 Sep 2026, 6:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

Three hundred games on the shelves and staff who will teach any of them. Tables for two to eight. Kitchen open until 9pm. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights.

Free · Details and tickets

Screen Printing Workshop

Tue 29 Sep 2026, 1:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

Print your own tote or tee from a design you bring or one of ours. Covers stencil cutting, ink mixing and pulling a clean print. All materials included. Under-18s welcome with an adult until 9pm.

$45 · Details and tickets

Poetry Slam

Wed 30 Sep 2026, 7:30pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

Eight poets, three rounds, one winner chosen by the room. Sign-up on the night; three-minute limit; no props, no music. Part of the hall's spring programme; see the full list on this page.

$10 · Details and tickets

Documentary Screening: The Weather Underground

Thu 1 Oct 2026, 7:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

The 2002 film about the 1970s American radical group, followed by a discussion led by a local historian. Ask at the bar about the concession rate.

$8 · Details and tickets

Beginners' Ceramics

Fri 2 Oct 2026, 10:30am

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

Hand-building only: pinch pots, coils and slabs. Pieces are fired and ready to collect a fortnight later. Aprons provided. Doors thirty minutes before the listed time.

$60 · Details and tickets

Community Choir (drop-in)

Sat 3 Oct 2026, 7:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End

No auditions and no need to read music. Songs are taught by ear in three parts; tea afterwards. Booking is not required but the room fills on wet nights.

$5 · Details and tickets

Sun 4 Oct 2026, 6:00pm

Fixture Hall, 1 Example Street, West End
